name: Clipper BayPass
description: Unlimited rides on Bay Area transit through participating colleges, employers, and housing providers
fullDescription: Clipper BayPass is the Bay Area's first prepaid, all-system transit pass, offering unlimited rides on Bay Area buses, trains, and ferries. It is provided through participating colleges, employers, and affordable housing organizations.
whatTheyOffer:
- Unlimited rides on participating Bay Area transit agencies
- Includes BART, Muni, AC Transit, Caltrain, VTA, and more
- Single pass covers buses, rail, and ferries
- Significant savings compared to paying per ride
howToGetIt:
1. Check if your college, employer, or housing provider participates
2. Get your BayPass on a Clipper card through that institution
3. Organizations can submit an interest form at clipperbaypass.com for a custom price quote
4. Program eligibility and fees vary by institution
keywords: Clipper, BayPass, college, university, student, unlimited transit, BART, Muni, AC Transit, Caltrain, VTA
